title: 2nd trial reporter Nur Aisyah
paragraphs: The 2nd trial for spreading false news against reporter Warta Malumku, Nur Aisyah, has been published.

According to the charges, Nur Aisyah published a report about the relief of the flood disaster on February 3, 2026, which the prosecutor judged to spread false information that caused havoc. The chapter used: section 28 verses (3) ITE Act (false information that caused havoc).
The trial was held at the Ambon State Court on May 26, 2026, where the panel of judges delayed the trial until June 16, 2026.
In the matter of Nur Aisyah, the power of the Phytri Handayni law stated that his client had been arrested 63 days and that the period of detention exceeded normal limits.
Nur Aisyah works as a reporter for Warta Malumku in Ambon.
The D.A. will read the charges to the next trial.
